messages:
alice: Heads-up — SDK PR #412 (sdk-js) is blocked by a backend proto rename (api/v2 -> api/v2beta). Need a quick cross-repo triage: SDK regen, console openapi, and helm values. @ben @carla

ben: On it. I looked at the backend diff — mostly proto path + minor swagger path rename. SDK will need a client-gen + small surface change. ETA today?

carla: I can cut the client-gen patch, but I need the final proto package path to regen. Dan, is backend PR 1287 ready to land?

dan: PR 1287 is open, waiting on one flaky test fix. I can push a fix today. Note: runtime's helm chart references service name selectors; package path rename shouldn't impact runtime selectors, but console openapi generator uses the proto path.

eva: TL;DR — proposed checklist: (1) merge backend (2) regen SDK + open PR (3) update console openapi config + manifest (4) helm values + canary rollout. I can handle console + helm once backend is merged.

ben: Suggested sequence: after backend merged -> run `make regen-client sdk-js` -> open SDK PR with CHANGELOG. Who can approve SDK PR quickly? @frank?

frank: I can review SDK PR today, but please include a repro test showing the client generation fix. Unit test is preferred.

merge-bot: merge-check: sdk-js#412 — status: blocked (depends on backend/PR-1287 failing CI).

carla: I'll prepare the SDK PR but will hold merge until runtime helm patch is annotated. Need confirmation whether runtime helm key is `apiServiceName` or `service.name`.

dan: It's `service.name` in runtime chart v1.2.0. The backend rename only changes package path, so runtime selectors are fine. The console openapi generator is the consumer that needs the updated path.

eva: OK — console team will update openapi generator config. I'll schedule a staging canary rollout for console-service after SDK merge. Target canary window: 16:00 PT today. Can backend be merged by 14:00 PT?

alice: 14:00 PT works. @dan can you push the test fix by 13:00 so we have a QA window?

dan: Yep — planning to push at 12:45 PT.

ben: I will open the SDK PR at ~13:30 PT. @frank please review when you can.

frank: Will review by 14:30 PT.

carla: Helm patch plan: small values change in console chart and add an annotation for canary rollout. I'll open the helm PR after openapi artifacts are confirmed. Adding `redwood/rollout: canary` annotation.

eva: I'll wire up quick smoke checks for staging canary:
```
# smoke check snippets
curl -sS https://staging-console.internal/health || exit 1
curl -sS https://staging-console.internal/api/v2/openapi.json | jq '.paths | length' > /tmp/openapi-size
```

ben: Note for SDK semver: bump minor since clients generated may change import paths (breaking for generated clients).

alice: Great. I'll add this whole handshake to the release checklist and ping infra for a quick staging slot. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

merge-bot: noted timeline: backend PR-1287 -> merged by 14:00 PT -> sdk-js#412 open at 13:30 PT -> review by 14:30 PT -> console canary 16:00 PT.
